Collaborative Dynamics grants a limited, worldwide, royalty-free permission to use its supplied names and marks exactly as they appear in an unmodified Impactful Tom release, solely to identify, describe, display, or redistribute that authentic release, including as a component of a larger commercial or noncommercial product.

This permission does not authorize altered marks, rebranded or modified Impactful Tom distributions, claims of authorship, or any suggestion that Collaborative Dynamics endorses a surrounding product. Modified software derived from MIT-licensed components must use a distinct identity unless separate written permission is granted.

Tom Bilyeu, Impact Theory, and related names, identities, titles, logos, and marks are third-party identifiers. Impactful Tom uses the Tom Bilyeu reference to identify the subject of a transformative, parodic machine impression and to distinguish that technical performance from an official source. The package claims no affiliation, endorsement, sponsorship, authorization, or official status, and it does not present generated output as Tom Bilyeu's authentic speech or advice.

Collaborative Dynamics' position is that this nominative, expressive, and parodic reference use is permitted by applicable law. That is the publisher's position, not an adjudicated legal conclusion. Other accurate nominative references and uses permitted by applicable law remain unaffected.
